editionLabel: English EmperorS4 rules, twenty-page publisher-linked PDF
location: Setup - Player step 4; Sequence of Play and Player Turns
firstPlayerRule: Whoever visited Italy most recently starts. If nobody has ever been there, choose the starting player randomly.
officialTieBreak: Random selection applies when nobody has visited Italy. No rule is given here for equally recent visits.
clarifications: The initial cube-pyramid construction is simultaneous; the selected player leads the player-turn phase.
This is Burano, the cube-pyramid game, rather than Walking in Burano.
